verification.verification_notes: Penguin Random House and multiple scholarly records verified the McKinney translation and the zuihitsu genre of private observation and lists. Public/private status of the work is disputed and is disclosed as a limitation.

limitations: Heian Japanese honorifics, poetic allusion, and register markers are only partly recoverable in English; the work's intended audience (private vs. courtly) is contested.
